basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) is engaging 06 Consultants for its Estate & Works Section on contract: 04 Consultant (JE-Civil) and 02 Consultant (JE-Electrical). The filled application form with self-attested documents in PDF is to be mailed to [email protected] by 1 December 2026, and no hard copy is to be sent by post or courier. The pay is a consolidated Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- per month.

qualification.details: The notice lists the engagement position as Consultant (Type – III) with one qualification, age limit and pay band for both posts. | The notice does not print the educational qualification separately for each post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

selection_process: The selection is a shortlisting-based interview. Applications received within the due date are shortlisted by a Committee
and only shortlisted candidates are considered for the further selection process.
The essential qualification and experience are minimum
and possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. If the number of applications is large

the Institute reserves the right to adopt a shortlisting criteria to restrict the number of eligible candidates called for the interview. The decision of the Committee is final and binding. The date of the selection process will be communicated separately by e-mail to provisionally shortlisted candidates only.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely on contract basis, initially for a period of 01 year. It can be extended up to 02 more years, subject to requirement and after review of satisfactory work performance based on functional need. It is purely a temporary engagement. Appearing in the interview and selection thereafter does not entitle a candidate to any claim for permanency on the regular establishment of IIT Delhi. Immediate joinee will be preferred. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, and to postpone or cancel the recruitment for any or all positions without assigning any reason. If any information is found false or incorrect at any stage, the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Consultant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- per month, consolidated

01.12.2026 (the form is to be mailed by this date)

content_sections.heading: About IIT Delhi
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Delhi is located at Hauz Khas, New Delhi – 110016, and its website is www.iitd.ac.in . This notice is issued by its Recruitment Cell. The Institute intends to conduct a shortlisting-based interview to engage the Consultants for its Estate & Works Section.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go by email to [email protected] . The notice does not give a subject line. Take the prescribed Application Form from the IIT Delhi website, www.iitd.ac.in , through the link Jobs@IITDelhi under the heading Non-Academic. Fill in the form and affix a recent passport size photograph. Give detailed information on educational qualification, with the percentage of marks or division obtained in each examination, and details of work experience. Attach self-attested copies of documents supporting educational qualification and experience, in PDF format. All scanned documents must be clearly legible, preferably at a resolution of 300 dpi or higher. Mail the form and documents to [email protected] by 01.12.2026. There is no need to submit a hard copy through Post/Courier. Only complete and duly filled application forms with all the supporting documents specified in the form will be considered. Incomplete or incorrectly filled forms, or resumes sent in place of the prescribed form, will be rejected and not considered for further stages.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice lists the engagement position as Consultant (Type – III) with one qualification, age limit and pay band for both posts. The notice does not print the educational qualification separately for each post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these roles and responsibilities, with "OR" printed after the first item: Original Building Construction Works, Maintenance and Renovation Works, including Roads, Drainage, Water Supply, preparation of estimates and design, etc. OR: Day-to-day maintenance, inspection, monitoring and technical supervision of electrical and allied building services of the Institute. Monitoring the operation and maintenance of HT/LT substations, transformers, HT/LT panels, electrical distribution systems, DG sets, UPS and associated equipment. Monitoring operation and maintenance of air-conditioning systems including split/ window ACs, VRF/VRV systems, Package Units, Chillers, pumps and associated electrical/ control systems. Monitoring and coordination of fire alarm, fire detection, firefighting, lifts, CCTV, EPABX etc.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form with a recent passport size photograph. Self-attested copies of documents supporting educational qualification, in PDF. Self-attested copies of documents supporting experience, in PDF. Originals of educational (academic and professional) and experience documents, to be produced at the time of Written Test/Interview/Joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is a shortlisting-based interview. Applications received within the due date are shortlisted by a Committee, and only shortlisted candidates are considered for the further selection process. The essential qualification and experience are minimum, and possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. If the number of applications is large, the Institute reserves the right to adopt a shortlisting criteria to restrict the number of eligible candidates called for the interview. The decision of the Committee is final and binding. The date of the selection process will be communicated separately by e-mail to provisionally shortlisted candidates only.

content_sections.heading: Contract Terms and Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on contract basis, initially for a period of 01 year. It can be extended up to 02 more years, subject to requirement and after review of satisfactory work performance based on functional need. It is purely a temporary engagement. Appearing in the interview and selection thereafter does not entitle a candidate to any claim for permanency on the regular establishment of IIT Delhi. Immediate joinee will be preferred. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, and to postpone or cancel the recruitment for any or all positions without assigning any reason. If any information is found false or incorrect at any stage, the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled.

faq.question: Q1. How many Consultant vacancies has IIT Delhi announced?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi has announced 06 Consultant posts for the Estate & Works Section: 04 Consultant (JE-Civil) and 02 Consultant (JE-Electrical).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Consultant?
faq.answer: The filled application form with documents is to be mailed to [email protected] by 01.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIT Delhi Consultant?
faq.answer: B.Tech./B.E. or equivalent of higher degree in Civil/ Electrical Engineering/ Electrical & Electronics Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA, plus minimum 01 year post-qualification relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIT Delhi Consultant?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 40 years, counted as on the cut-off date of 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an IIT Delhi Consultant?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- per month. It is commensurate with the candidate's domain knowledge, skills and experience.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IIT Delhi Consultant?
faq.answer: Download the prescribed Application Form from www.iitd.ac.in (Jobs@IITDelhi, Non-Academic), fill it, add a photograph and self-attested document copies in PDF, and email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Do I need to send a hard copy by post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says there is no need to submit a hard copy through Post/Courier.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Through a shortlisting-based interview. A Committee shortlists applications received by the due date, and the interview date is sent by e-mail to provisionally shortlisted candidates only.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIT Delhi Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract engagement for 01 year initially, extendable up to 02 more years, and gives no claim to permanency on the regular establishment of IIT Delhi.
